tiers.J: coded PoC with a published platform or sponsor outcome
tiers.X: exploit-by-construction reproduction with no platform judgement
tiers.N: negative control: secure-path test or a PoC a judge rejected for the PoC being wrong

kinds.test-file: a test file (Rust #[test]/#[tokio::test] or TS it/test) meant to drive a harness
kinds.test-fragment: statements or an it()/#[test] block meant to be added to an existing test
kinds.rust-unit-test: a Rust #[test] that calls program functions directly, driving no Solana harness
kinds.script: a TS/JS script run with node (no it/test), e.g. a CTF client or a replaced deploy script
kinds.binary-main: a Rust binary with fn main (PoC framework or CTF client)
kinds.ctf-solve-program: an on-chain attacker program (entrypoint), not a test
